verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring payments or filings is a reasonable thing to ask of a tax e-services portal, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off actions: electronic filing, batch enrollment files and making a payment. The 'Installment Payment Option' heading is an adjacent payment-plan feature, not a documented ability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
